ai-agents: Claude Code v2.1.332 fixes a regression where claude auth login falsely reported "Login successful" on failure; it now exits with code 1 and states what to check.

ai-models: Xiaomi lists MiMo-V2.6-Flash-MOPD on OpenRouter, a mixture-of-experts model with 309B total and 15B active parameters, a 1M-token context window, and native multimodal input.
Upstage's Solar Pro 4 Contributor on OpenRouter is the Solar Pro 4 model at a lower rate, with the condition that Upstage may use interaction data to improve its models.
ai-policy: New York has enacted bill S 9408, which prohibits chatbot toys.
ai-data: Snowflake Terraform users managing preview snowflake_table, snowflake_tables data source, or snowflake_failover_group resources face breaking changes in provider v2.24.0; a migration guide covers the required updates.

OpenMetadata users get a major release (2.1.0) adding data quality failure thresholds, dimension-based test grouping, grouped incident management, workflow conditions on data product assets and column changes, service-level tag inheritance, impersonation policy conditions, entity lifecycle stages, domain styling, and glossary settings.
